results.title: Hermes Agent — Open-Source AI Agent with Memory, Skills, and Cron
results.snippet: Hermes Agent is an open-source AI agent from Nous Research that can remember context, use tools, learn reusable skills, run scheduled jobs, and operate from the terminal, dashboard, GitHub workflows, and messaging channels.

results.title: Hermes One - Your AI Agent, Always Improving
results.snippet: Hermes One is a self-improving AI assistant with tool use, multi-platform messaging, and a closed learning loop. Free, open source, and available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

results.title: AI Tool: Hermes 3 - NOUS RESEARCH for Simplified Processes
results.snippet: Hermes 3, developed by Nous Research, is an open-source AI model built on Llama 3.1, designed for advanced reasoning, creative problem-solving, and interactive dialogue. It excels in long-term memory retention, multi-turn conversations, roleplaying, and agentic function-calling.

results.title: What is Hermes Agent? Understand this self-evolving... - Apiyi.com Blog
results.snippet: Hermes Agent is an open-source, "self-evolving" AI agent framework released by Nous Research in 2026. Its core superpower? It learns from every conversation you have, summarizing new skills, improving its own performance, and building long-term memory as it goes.

results.title: Nous Hermes 3: an open-weight agentic model – Jacar
results.snippet: Hermes 3 is Nous Research's family of open-weight models, fine-tuned on Llama 3.1 in 8B, 70B and 405B sizes. Its strength is tool use through JSON-formatted function calls.
